description: ♾️ Collection and Roadmap for everyone who wants DevSecOps. Hope your DevOps are more safe 😎

summary.one_liner: A curated DevSecOps roadmap and link collection organized by SDLC stage (design, develop, build, test, deploy, operate/monitor), with a separate tools list and CI/CD security section.
summary.what_it_does: This is an awesome-style list rather than a software project. It is organized as a roadmap with numbered sections for each DevSecOps lifecycle stage, from an overview through Design, Develop, Build, Test, Deploy, and Operate and Monitor. Each stage links out to articles, guides, standards, and official documentation, covering topics such as threat modeling, secure coding guides, SAST and DAST, penetration testing, Kubernetes and Docker image hardening, and RASP/IAST. A dedicated "Security of CICD" section collects hardening resources for GitHub Actions and Jenkins. The README also points to a separate Tools list (SAST, DAST, secret management, threat modeling, component analysis, and more) and to other roadmaps from the U.S. Department of Defense, Larry Maccherone, and GitLab. The README does not describe a tooling or code artifact beyond these links and lists.
use_cases: Learning the DevSecOps lifecycle stage by stage
Finding SAST and DAST resources for a CI pipeline
Hardening GitHub Actions or Jenkins pipelines
Reading threat modeling and secure coding guides
Locating OWASP and NIST secure development frameworks
notable: Lifecycle-ordered roadmap from design through operate and monitor
Separate curated Tools list linked from the README
Dedicated Security of CICD section for GitHub Actions and Jenkins
Links to OWASP SAST and DAST maturity levels and OWASP DSOVS
Cross-links to other DevSecOps roadmaps from DoD, GitLab, and others
caveats: Link-only list; the README provides no tools or code to install
Some sections are thin or incomplete, such as an empty Awesome Resources heading and a broken GitHub Actions link
Includes a DEPRECATED Jenkins hardening entry
